rules: Finished target Q remains unchanged; loss upper bound p prepares up to Q*(1+p/100) material at the frozen base BOM.
The operator supplies actual receipt quantity; never initialize it from a theoretical capacity.
With sufficient own material, receipts between Q and Q*(1+p/100) are normal; partial deliveries preserve their unfulfilled target.
Consume base BOM against new actual receipt quantities. Reported waste and returns remain independent facts.
Preserve all previously approved version-1 quantities, costs and reversal slices.
Private demand coverage is capped by original demand; normal excess is public supply.
Use exact server fields orderedQty, pendingReturnQty, materialReceivableQty and normalMaxReceivableQty; clients do not recalculate authoritative quantities.
Actual IQC and warehouse stock confirmation, not a registration draft or theoretical capacity, release usable stock.
Preserve authorization, source identity, request generations, drafts, idempotency and unknown submission recovery.
futureNativeRequirements: Port the full owning business entry and applicable write lifecycle before exposing a native action.
Use the shared vectors and actual service contracts for both architectures.
Keep existing task status, owner, dependencies and DoD until native implementation and target-machine evidence exist.
